sources.title: Date Calculator
sources.snippet: This free date calculator computes the difference between two dates. It can also add to or subtract from a date. Both can deal with business days and holidays.

sources.title: PubChem
sources.snippet: PubChem is the world's largest collection of freely accessible chemical information. Search chemicals by name, molecular formula, structure, and other identifiers. Find chemical and physical properties, biological activities, safety and toxicity information, patents, literature citations and more.
